svg.text: Auth & accounts · F11 Proposal upload · F12 P1/P2/P3 deadlines · F13 Proposal review · F14 Notifications + email · F15 Deadline extension
/name = derived attribute; italic name = abstract class
+ uploadProposal(phase: Phase, title: String, abstract: String, pdf: File): ProposalVersion
+ requestExtension(m: GroupMilestone, days: int, reason: String): ExtensionRequest
+ commentOnSection(v: ProposalVersion, section: String, body: String): FeedbackThread
+ reviewProposal(v: ProposalVersion, d: ReviewDecision, note: String): ProposalReview
+ setMilestone(p: Phase, dueAt: DateTime, graceDays: int, penaltyPerDay: int): void
+ notify(to: User, type: NotificationType, title: String, body: String): Notification
+ status(now: DateTime): String {not_set | open | grace | closed}
